newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver end steady, raids hits supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver end steady, raids hits supply.

text.p: Gold lost early gains on fresh offerings following reports of sliding global prices on Wednesday, dealers said.
Arrivals were affected by recent income tax raids on traders, the said.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) opened higher at 57,200 rupees against previous closing of 57,100 rupees but dropped thereafter and concluded at 57,100 rupees per piece.
Silver opened lower on the back of overnight losses in the world market but fresh industrial buying and limited arrivals at the reduced level trimmed early losses towards the close.
Silver was down by 25 rupees per kg on Tuesday.
